testCountReconciliation.explanation: The 892 vs 479 discrepancy arose from confusing the Vitest test assertion count (which was 898 in the prior phase baseline, earlier colloquially referenced as ~892) with the file count audited during scan:credentials (479 files at an earlier commit). The true metrics are 922 Vitest tests across 54 test files (100% PASS) and 575 scanned files (0 credentials found).

scenarios.title: 合法 SQLite 创建快照
scenarios.precondition: Legitimate SQLite database file exists on disk with DELETE journal mode
scenarios.action: Invoke CustomDictionaryValidator.createSnapshot using VACUUM INTO on read-only connection
scenarios.observedResult: Snapshot created successfully: size=45056 bytes, entries=2
scenarios.limitations: Bound to files within local filesystem access bounds

scenarios.title: 合法快照验证
scenarios.precondition: Valid SQLite candidate database exists
scenarios.action: Invoke CustomDictionaryValidator.validateSnapshot in isolated worker
scenarios.observedResult: Verified valid: schemaVersion=1, entries=2, forms=2, examples=1
scenarios.limitations: Schema version pinned to 1

scenarios.title: 无效 SQLite 头
scenarios.precondition: File contains non-SQLite arbitrary text header
scenarios.action: Invoke validateSnapshot on invalid header file
scenarios.observedResult: Verification rejected with code: INVALID_SQLITE_FILE
scenarios.limitations: Header validation via DatabaseSync readOnly open check

scenarios.title: 缺少必需表
scenarios.precondition: Database missing forms and examples tables
scenarios.action: Execute schema table check in validator worker
scenarios.observedResult: Rejection message: Database is missing required table: "forms"
scenarios.limitations: All 4 core tables (meta, entries, forms, examples) mandatory

scenarios.title: 缺少必需列
scenarios.precondition: Database table entries missing phonetic column
scenarios.action: Execute PRAGMA table_info column verification
scenarios.observedResult: Rejection message: Table "entries" is missing required column: "phonetic"
scenarios.limitations: Full column set verified per schema contract

scenarios.title: 无效 Schema version
scenarios.precondition: Database meta table contains schema_version = 42
scenarios.action: Validate schema_version in worker
scenarios.observedResult: Rejection message: Database schema_version is 42, expected 1
scenarios.limitations: Requires exact version 1

scenarios.title: 缺失必要索引
scenarios.precondition: Database forms and examples tables have no secondary indexes
scenarios.action: Execute EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN against lookup queries in worker
scenarios.observedResult: Rejection message: Missing required index on forms(headword); query plan requires table scan (SCAN forms; USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY)
scenarios.limitations: EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN requires B-Tree search, rejects table scan

scenarios.title: 实际查词 SQL 兼容
scenarios.precondition: Standard compatible database with entries, forms, and examples
scenarios.action: Execute exact entry lookup, morphology resolution, and examples queries
scenarios.observedResult: Queries passed cleanly; sampled headwords: [apple, banana]
scenarios.limitations: Probes sampled up to 5 headwords

scenarios.title: WAL 已提交未 checkpoint 数据
scenarios.precondition: Database in WAL mode with commit A checkpointed and commit B residing in -wal file only
scenarios.action: Create snapshot using VACUUM INTO on read-only connection and verify contents
scenarios.observedResult: Snapshot captured both commits: entryCount=2, hitA=true, hitB=true
scenarios.limitations: VACUUM INTO creates standalone single-file SQLite database integrating WAL pages

scenarios.title: 复制期间并发写入
scenarios.precondition: Active writer executing concurrent INSERT queries while snapshot is being taken
scenarios.action: Execute snapshot creation in parallel with concurrent writer
scenarios.observedResult: Snapshot completed without deadlock or corruption: state=PUBLISHED, appleHit=true
scenarios.limitations: SQLite multi-version concurrency control ensures reader isolation

scenarios.title: 源文件中途替换
scenarios.precondition: Snapshot created and verified in staging
scenarios.action: Overwrite source file with corrupt bytes and verify snapshot dictionary integrity
scenarios.observedResult: Snapshot remains isolated and intact: hit.found=true
scenarios.limitations: Staging and published files reside in managed customSnapshotDirectory

scenarios.title: 轻量指纹绕过反例
scenarios.precondition: Two database files with identical size and structure but 1-byte data difference
scenarios.action: Compare size and full SHA-256 digest
scenarios.observedResult: sameSize=true, diffHash=true
scenarios.limitations: Proves size/mtime alone cannot substitute full SHA-256 integrity digest

scenarios.title: 受管快照内容独立于源路径变化
scenarios.precondition: Snapshot published to customSnapshotDirectory
scenarios.action: Mutate source database and delete source database
scenarios.observedResult: Snapshot isolated from source mutations and deletions: missExt.found=false, hitApple.found=true
scenarios.assertions: missExt.found === false && hitApple.found === true && existsSync(srcDb) === false
scenarios.limitations: Snapshot owns separate storage page tree

scenarios.title: Worker 超时
scenarios.precondition: Worker task assigned 1ms timeout
scenarios.action: Execute snapshot creation exceeding timeout budget
scenarios.observedResult: ValidatorTimeoutError caught with code TIMEOUT: true
scenarios.limitations: Worker thread forcefully terminated via worker.terminate() upon timeout

scenarios.title: Worker 取消
scenarios.precondition: AbortSignal aborted prior to worker execution
scenarios.action: Schedule worker task with aborted signal
scenarios.observedResult: ValidatorCancelledError caught with code CANCELLED: true
scenarios.limitations: AbortSignal listener deregistered upon settlement

scenarios.title: Worker 异常退出
scenarios.precondition: Invalid target passed to supervisor
scenarios.action: Execute worker task and observe error handling and cleanup
scenarios.observedResult: Supervisor gracefully captured error; runningCount=0
scenarios.limitations: Supervisor internal queue drains cleanly on error

scenarios.title: Windows 句柄释放
scenarios.precondition: SQLite database validated in worker thread on Windows
scenarios.action: Unlink validated SQLite file immediately after worker exits
scenarios.observedResult: File unlinked cleanly without EBUSY/EPERM: true
scenarios.limitations: SQLite connection closed in try/finally block before worker termination

scenarios.title: 用户文件零删除
scenarios.precondition: User source database located outside managed storage
scenarios.action: Execute snapshot creation, publishing, and subsequent cleanup
scenarios.observedResult: User file exists: true, SHA matches: true, size matches: true
scenarios.assertions: exists === true && origHash === afterHash && origStat.size === afterStat.size
scenarios.limitations: User database treated strictly as immutable read-only input

scenarios.title: 受管目录 symlink/junction 安全
scenarios.precondition: Managed customSnapshotDirectory resolved
scenarios.action: Validate paths with path traversal and invalid filename contracts
scenarios.observedResult: traversalCaught=true, namingCaught=true
scenarios.limitations: Requires canonical directory containment and CUSTOM_SNAPSHOT_FILENAME_PATTERN

scenarios.title: 失败快照清理
scenarios.precondition: Candidate database fails schema verification
scenarios.action: Execute createAndPublishSnapshot on failing database and check staging directory
scenarios.observedResult: Creation rejected; remaining staging files: 0
scenarios.limitations: Temporary staging-*.sqlite3 unlinked in failure catch block

scenarios.title: 发布过程异常与原子提交边界
scenarios.precondition: Staging snapshot verified by worker
scenarios.action: Re-verify SHA-256 pre-publish and atomically rename staging to published
scenarios.observedResult: Atomic publish succeeded: state=PUBLISHED, publishedExists=true, stagingExists=false
scenarios.limitations: fs.rename guarantees atomic file replacement on same filesystem

scenarios.title: 峰值 RSS 与 event-loop
scenarios.precondition: Event loop lag monitor running at 20ms interval
scenarios.action: Execute snapshot creation, validation, and publication
scenarios.observedResult: Peak RSS: 67.89 MiB (< 512 MiB), Max event-loop lag: 4.00 ms (< 200 ms)
scenarios.limitations: Worker thread isolates SQLite CPU and I/O from Node event loop

scenarios.title: custom-local 来源验证
scenarios.precondition: DictionaryManager initialized with custom mode and custom-local source
scenarios.action: Verify source provenance propagation and lookup capabilities
scenarios.observedResult: dictSource=custom-local, mgrSource=custom-local, mgrMode=custom, hit.found=true
scenarios.limitations: Source contract strictly enforces custom-local for mode custom

scenarios.title: dispose 与验证竞态
scenarios.precondition: Worker task in-flight
scenarios.action: Invoke validator.dispose concurrently with running task
scenarios.observedResult: Disposed cleanly: isDisposed=true, runningCount=0
scenarios.limitations: Disposed validator terminates active workers and rejects queued tasks fail-closed
